integrity_statement: Proof and definitions are supplied, with a standalone illustrative exact-arithmetic check; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit premium and positive zero-claim probabilities at every phase; negative per-period mean drift; a common exponential moment; simple nonunit kernel roots in the closed unit disk. Multiple-root, general-premium and heavy-tailed cases are not asserted.
title: A uniqueness principle for seasonal ruin root matrices
